user.title: Connect El-Overblik HA
user.description: Enter a Customer API refresh token and already-linked metering points from eloverblik.dk. Readings are delayed, not live.

reconfigure.title: Change metering points
reconfigure.description: Enter the token and complete list of meters to keep. Removed meters retain historical statistics.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace ElOverblik token
reauth_confirm.description: Create or activate a Customer API refresh token in ElOverblik, then enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token. Check that it is an active Customer API token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read ElOverblik data. Try again later.
error.invalid_meters: Enter one or more 18-digit metering-point IDs, separated by commas.
error.overlapping_meters: One or more meters are already configured in another El-Overblik HA entry.
error.missing_relation: One or more meters cannot be accessed. Check the IDs and link the meters in ElOverblik before continuing.

init.title: History and updates
init.description: Import 12 months by default or choose all available history. Language follows your Home Assistant profile (Danish or English).

data.configure_prices: Configure market prices and contracts per meter

data_description.all_history: Previous five years plus the current year, subject to access.
data_description.history_start: Ignored when all available history is selected.
data_description.poll_hours: Between 1 and 24 hours. Readings may arrive several days late.

meter.title: Prices for meter ending {meter}
meter.description: Choose DK1 (west of the Great Belt) or DK2 (east). Optional energy-only comparison: fixed rate or spot plus markup, in DKK/kWh. Excludes grid charges, electricity taxes and subscriptions. VAT-inclusive inputs are divided by 1.25; results exclude VAT. The effective date confirms when these terms apply. Changing historical terms requires a new effective date; older estimates become unavailable.

data.rate: Fixed energy rate or spot markup (DKK/kWh)

error.invalid_date: Choose a valid date (history must be within API retention and no later than today).
error.invalid_rate: Enter a finite decimal rate in DKK/kWh.
error.choose_area: Choose DK1 or DK2 for a contract comparison.
error.new_effective_date: Set a new effective date when changing historical contract terms.

options.DK1: DK1 · West of the Great Belt
options.DK2: DK2 · East of the Great Belt

dashboard.introduction: Your electricity, at a glance. Open a meter for trends, market prices and energy-only estimates. Measurements are delayed; meters are not added together because their coverage may overlap. This dashboard is integration-managed. Copy its cards into your own dashboard to customize them.
dashboard.delayed: Reported energy, not live power. The latest complete day may be several days old. Month/year figures include only reported readings.
dashboard.awaiting_history: Waiting for historical readings. Import progress is shown below.
dashboard.coverage: **Month coverage · reported / expected hours · covered through**
dashboard.stale_warning: **Delayed or unavailable data.** Check the latest measurement and import status before interpreting totals.
dashboard.price_basis: Wholesale spot prices · DKK/kWh excluding VAT, grid charges, taxes and supplier fees. Source: [Energinet DayAheadPrices](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/DayAheadPrices). Currency conversion may differ from your supplier.
dashboard.unpublished: Prices are not yet published or coverage is incomplete. No missing interval is treated as zero.
dashboard.configure_prices: Open Settings → Devices & services → El-Overblik HA → Configure. Select 'Configure market prices and contracts per meter', then choose DK1/DK2 and optionally enter your energy contract.
dashboard.cost_basis: **Energy-only estimates, not your bill.** Excludes VAT, electricity taxes, grid charges and subscriptions. Each hour uses the average of its four spot prices, assuming uniform consumption within that hour. Positive difference = premium to wholesale; negative = discount. This is not a guaranteed saving.
dashboard.configure_contract: Add an optional contract in the integration options to compare your energy rate with wholesale.
dashboard.incomplete_energy: Waiting for a complete consumption day.
dashboard.outside_contract: The latest complete consumption day predates these contract terms. No retroactive estimate is made.
dashboard.unsupported_period: Market comparisons before 1 October 2025 are not supported.
dashboard.incomplete_prices: Waiting for complete matching market prices. Automatic comparison history is limited to the last 31 days.
dashboard.ready: Complete matching consumption and prices. Both amounts use the same energy and exclude VAT.
dashboard.price_health: **Market prices last fetched · latest published interval end · source error (if any)**

meter_access.title: ElOverblik access lost for meter ending {meter}
meter_access.description: Check the meter relation and authorized period in ElOverblik. This integration is read-only and cannot link meters. Other meters continue updating.

authentication_failed.message: ElOverblik rejected authentication. Replace the refresh token using Home Assistant's reauthentication flow.

dated_charges_unavailable.message: ElOverblik's live service does not expose the documented dated-charge endpoint. Current reported charges remain available through Get reported charges. Historical charge calculations are not available.

entry_unavailable.message: The selected El-Overblik HA entry is not loaded.

unknown_meter.message: Select only meters configured in this integration entry.

history_busy.message: A historical import is already running. Check its status sensor.

refresh_busy.message: Please wait one minute before refreshing again.

invalid_period.message: Choose a valid period within the API history limit, ending no later than tomorrow. The end date is exclusive.

charge_query_failed.message: Unable to retrieve charges. Use timezone-aware timestamps, a maximum of 31 days and at most 10 configured meters.

import_history.name: Import or reconcile historical energy
import_history.description: Start a background import for all meters in an entry. Returns a job ID; progress is shown by the historical import sensor.

get_charges.name: Get reported charges
get_charges.description: Return cached source-reported tariffs, subscriptions and fees. Not a complete bill or a calculated current rate.

get_charge_schedule.name: Get dated charge information
get_charge_schedule.description: Retrieve charge links and dated source prices for up to 10 meters and 31 days. Requires timestamps with UTC offsets. Does not calculate costs.
